content: DX7 EG has 4 segments (R1L1..R4L4). Decay segments are pure exponential in the log domain (tlbflush.org part 3: at rate=50, 44.1kHz, decay constant d=0.00104, time-constant T=961.1 samples ~= 21.8ms). Rising/attack segments follow a quadratic-in-time shape near the transition, not a simple exponential (tlbflush.org part 4). Levels are non-linear: level 50 is close to zero amplitude, level 80 is less than half of level 99 (tlbflush.org part 2, empirical DX7 recording analysis).
